QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Subani's Legacy
QuestInfo.0: Listen to the rest of John's story.
QuestInfo.1: John asks for your help in exploring MesoGears, the underground area beneath Bigger Ben, and asks you to let him know if you find anything. Perhaps you should see what's down there.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered Christopher Crimsonheart's gravestone in the depths of MesoGears and wondered why he would be buried there, of all places.

npc.0: Give me a sign if you find something interesting and I'll be there in the blink of an eye!

mob.0: Take out 200 of each type of monster while you're down there!
